    (hx : x ∈ (K(n + 1))) (c : B) :

      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j side n x c := by

    C RZ pi S S hS side c

    (relThetaWindowEquiv C RZ pi (S + q * S)
      (relThetaPairH1_windowS_add_mulS C pi hpi g q)).symm s
  have hz := exists_relationReadMultipleWitness_pureWindow
    (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j side q n z x hx
  have hread : divUniversalPureWindowCoefficientRead (C := C) (pi := pi)
      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j side q z = c := by
    change relThetaResSide (S + q * S) side le_rfl

        (relThetaPairH1_windowS_add_mulS C pi hpi g q) z) = c
    simpa [z] using hs
  rwa [hread] at hz
